label: The chunk "ass" when the tokenizer cuts it off as its own piece: after a hyphen in compounds (Steam-Assisted, Quality-Assurance, power-assisted, self-assessment, lane-assist, character-assassination), at the start of names like Assam and Assassin's Creed, and the standalone word for a donkey. Quiet for ordinary whole words that merely contain the letters (assist, assess, assets, assignment, Assembly, class, glass, embassy, Massachusetts, unhyphenated "Quality Assurance") and for hyphen splits that give "-as" (machine-assembled). Weak (about 0.3-0.4) on short words ending in -ass (grass, bass, brass).

probed_before.source: this checkout's .probe-log, before the pre-registration commit
